fields.description: Uncheck to keep accepting and logging webhooks without sending any email.
fields.label: Email Notifications Enabled

fields.description: Leave empty to use the site's default outgoing email account.
fields.label: From Email

fields.description: Repeats of the same event for the same site inside this window are logged as Suppressed instead of emailed. 0 disables it.
fields.label: Dedupe Window (minutes)

fields.description: Master token accepted by every group. Off by default: one leaked value would forge events for all groups.
fields.label: Global Secret

fields.description: Reject an event whose site is not listed on the bench group whose token was used. Turn this off only if you add sites in Frappe Cloud faster than you list them here.
fields.label: Strict Site Binding

fields.description: Also accept the global secret below, on every group.
fields.label: Allow Global Secret

fields.description: Hand mail to the background queue instead of sending it inside the webhook request. Faster responses, but needs workers running and the log says Sent once it is queued.
fields.label: Send Emails In Background
